manuela calderon.name: Manuela Calderon
manuela calderon.origin: Manny Calderon's mother worked as the live-in help at St. Estes Home for Boys, the location of Cletus Kasady's first confirmed mass murder. She was the sole survivor of this tragedy. She joined the Army, and became a twice-decorated veteran of the Afghan War, having served three tours. After retiring, Manny started working as the director of security for Grey Ridge Investments. When her employer, managing director Barry Gleason did a background check and discovered her link to Cletus Kasady, who had become the supervillain "Carnage", he reached out to the FBI with a proposal, to use Calderon as a bait for a trap in a played-out mine in West Virginia for profit. Manny accepted, and her profile was subsequently raised to get Carnage's attention, knowing he would try to kill her. Carnage was lured to the Grey Ridge Mine, and Calderon fended him off until the sonic cannons provided by the US Army were activated to weaken Kasady's symbiote, allowing for the serial murder to be captured. However, the cannons shook through the backfill over an old tunnel the FBI had not been informed of, and the ground swallowed Carnage and several agents, forcing FBI agents Claire Dixon and Eddie Brock, army soldier John Jameson, and Calderon herself to go down to the dark underground to capture Carnage and save the agents. The team delved deeper into the mine to confront Carnage, ultimately discovering the entire operation and its downfall was part of a plan orchestrated by the mine's owner Barry Gleason to sacrifice Carnage in a temple hidden deep within the mines for a Chthonic ritual. The team failed to apprehend Carnage, who had been empowered by Gleason's ritual instead of killed, and had escaped with the ritual book, the Darkhold. Even after the Anti-Carnage task force was discharged by the FBI, it continued operating with funding from Victoria Montesi, an occult expert looking for the Darkhold. Early into their new adventure, they were joined by Jubulile van Scotter, a young woman who assisted Kassady on her boat when she found him adrift, unaware he was a homicidal lunatic. Jubulile had also been merged to a symbiote in a failed attempt from Carnage to control her before she escaped from him, granting her a psychic bond with Carnage. Montesi's team finally located Carnage after the maniac delved deep into a mysterious uncharted island. Unfortunately, they arrived late, as Carnage had reached an ancient temple where he started a ritual to summon the Elder God Chthon. Armed with her own symbiote, the Toxin symbiote from Brock, and the Raze symbiote from Dixon, Jubulile confronted Chthon when he arrived. Montesi retrieved the Darkhold from Carnage and used it to further empower Jubulile with the psychic energies of the entire world. This final power-up allowed Jubulile to banish Chthon. When the dust settled, the anti-Carnage task force disbanded. Their members bid farewell to each other and parted ways. Manny offered Victoria, with whom she shared mutual affinity, the chance to return to the States with her. However, Montesi refused, stating it was her responsibility to deliver the Darkhold to the Children of the Midnight Sun. When Manny wondered if she would see Victoria again, Montesi assured her time had many stories to tell.

mao tse tung.name: Mao Tse Tung
mao tse tung.origin: Mao Tse Tung was the leader of the People's Republic of China from 1949 until his death in 1976. In the Earth-616 universe he was depicted as the leader of a "Communist nation" that often operated behind the "Bamboo Curtain". Chairman Mao oversaw the deployment of the Radioactive Man to fight Thor, and the Missing Link to be unleashed on American soil. The creature was ultimately stopped by the Hulk, and Russia apparently captured the Hulk. Mao also sent agents to America to steal S.H.I.E.L.D.'s latest designs for a new prototype Life Model Decoy in order to make a replica of Captain America in order to make him look bad in the eyes of the American public. This prototype would prove to be faulty, and destroyed by Captain America himself. Soon after that event, the international terrorist Mandarin mind-controlled the Hulk and sent him in a rampage to China. Mandarin's goal was to make each national power believe that other powers have attacked, unleashing a worldwide war so that he could get the profits. Indeed Mao himself deployed the Chinese army against the Hulk, believing that the Russians were behind the treacherous plot. The Hulk and Nick Fury of S.H.I.E.L.D. stopped the Mandarin.

His appearances were all in comics that were published in 1963-1968, when Mao was still in power. Mao Tse Tung's face was shown in the art of while Belathauzer explained how members of his demonic race already roam Earth disguised as humans in order to sow discord and create chaos, implying that Mao is secretly a demon. It is unclear if this is actually the case.

mar sohn.origin: Mar-Sohn was in the city New Kree-Lar when his planet was bombarded by the phenomenon known as the White Event. After it passed, Mar-Sohn was completely transformed into Kree-Pama's Nightmask. Sohn travelled all of Kree-Pama to look for the rest of the heralds. He came upon Joras-Kyl who was transformed into the Cipher at the Oceanic Science Station Pama-16. Nightmask's next journey led him and Cipher to the Temple of Pama, where they were introduced Trrunk, the Justice of the Kree. After the three were together, they returned to New Kree-Lar to search for Va-Sohn, Mar-sohn's sister, who was the candidate to become the Kree Starbrand after Kree-Pama's Last White Event. As they found her, the White Event started, and, due to the absence of a Spitfire, the entity which would provide a counterforce to Starbrand's powers, the first thing she did with her newly acquired powers was to kill her brother and Trrunk, stating that all she needed was the intelligence Cipher could provide.

mar vell skrull impostor.species: Skrull (Warskrull specialized in the imitation of superhumans)
mar vell skrull impostor.origin: This Skrull was among the best and brightest of the Warskrulls, and was selected by Skrull scientists to specialize in imitation of superhuman Earthlings, with the intent of eventually replacing Earth's heroes. The Skrull was permanently turned into a copy of the Kree warrior, Mar-Vell, to avoid any possible detection. However, a problem emerged when the real Mar-Vell died. The Skrull was no longer useful to the training program. And he couldn't return to his true form, preventing him from returning to his normal life. However, he wasn't just going to lie down and die. The Skrull allied himself with two other Skrulls in the same situation, posing as the deceased heroes, John Proudstar and Adam Warlock. After some time, they had a run-in with Kitty Pryde, whom they mistook for her Skrull impostor and took her prisoner. Realizing that she was the real deal and that Galactus was about to arrive, they let her go and joined forces with her and Wolverine, in an attempt to save their people and the X-Men. The Skrull was ultimately gunned down by another Skrull, when he attempted to stop a Skrull General from keeping people from getting onboard a spaceship.

fields.history: This Skrull was among the best and brightest of the Warskrulls, and was selected by Skrull scientists to specialize in imitation of superhuman Earthlings, with the intent of eventually replacing Earth's heroes. The Skrull was permanently turned into a copy of the Kree warrior, Mar-Vell, to avoid any possible detection. However, a problem emerged when the real Mar-Vell died. The Skrull was no longer useful to the training program. And he couldn't return to his true form, preventing him from returning to his normal life. However, he wasn't just going to lie down and die. The Skrull allied himself with two other Skrulls in the same situation, posing as the deceased heroes, John Proudstar and Adam Warlock. After some time, they had a run-in with Kitty Pryde, whom they mistook for her Skrull impostor and took her prisoner. Realizing that she was the real deal and that Galactus was about to arrive, they let her go and joined forces with her and Wolverine, in an attempt to save their people and the X-Men. The Skrull was ultimately gunned down by another Skrull, when he attempted to stop a Skrull General from keeping people from getting onboard a spaceship.
powers: Skrull Shape-Shifting
equipment: Nega-Bands: Utilizes a Skrull-manufactured pair of Nega-Bands.

mara battleworld.name: Mara (Battleworld)
mara battleworld.origin: Like every creature found on the Beyonder's Battleworld following the events of the first Secret Wars, Mara was the product of the subconscious mind of the Fantastic Four's Thing, the Thing had decided to remain on Battleworld after discovering he could change back and forth between human and Thing forms. Each of these creations were based off some aspect of Ben's memories or personality, with entirely fabricated backgrounds and origins. Mara was the defender of the kingdom of Muab, for reasons unknown, it's future ruler Juneyar was taken out of the city in a caravan. However if he was away from the kingdom for more than a month it would succumb to the power of black magic. The boy was sought after by Grimm the Sorcerer who sent his minions to attack the caravan. The attackers were prevented from stealing the boy by the Thing and his companion Tarianna. The boy's caretaker, Tabith had the Thing swear to get the boy to Muab before she died. Nicknaming the child "Junior" (which Tarianna pronounced "Juneyar") the couple made the dangerous trek to Muab. Meanwhile. Mara used her powers to reach out across Battleworld in the hopes of finding the child, but to no avail. Along the way Ben became attached to the child and briefly considered keeping him but decided against it. They were impeded by minions of the Sorcerer but made it to the city of Muab. When the Sorcerer made a last ditch effort to capture the child, Ben was forced to choose rescuing the child over Tarianna who was spirited away. After getting the child to Muab, Ben learned how important Juneyar was to these people. However, even though he was hailed as a hero, the Thing did not longer and departed shortly thereafter to rescue Tarianna. Presumably when the Thing later left Battleworld, Mara ceased to exist before the planet self-destructed.
powers: user who could at least use her magical abilities to teleport.

mara cimmerian.name: Mara (Cimmerian)
mara cimmerian.origin: Mara was once Conan's playmate. She wished him luck for his age ceremony on his fifteenth birthday. She was destined to become his bride, if he had remained in the Snowhawk village. At some point while Conan was away, he wronged the wizard Thoth-Amon, who chose to take revenge on the barbarian by taking his home. He achieved this by taking control of the dogs of Gwawl, the Dog-Keeper, and slowly infecting everyone else in Snowhawk Village including Mara. Eventually Conan returned home, with many gifts from his adventurers across Hyboria, but was forced to use these gifts to non-fatally stop the Snowhawk Tribe before he killed Gwawl, freeing Mara and the Cimmerians from Thoth-Amon's control. The tribe then killed the remaining Wild Dogs of Cimmeria. Years later, Mara's village was raided by Vanir raiders led by Thorfel the Fair. Mara was taken, with the intent of being made Thorfel's bride. Conan attempted to rescue her, but Mara had had already killed herself with Thorfel's dagger rather than marry him. Conan eventually killed Thorfel in revenge.

mara arliss.name: Mara Arliss
mara arliss.origin: Mara was a member of a nomadic Atlantean colony. One day she met Todd Arliss aka the Tiger Shark who was going by the identity of Arlys Tigershark. She tried to help the criminal reject his violent nature, and the pair married. The couple soon conceived a child, and upon visiting an Atlantean Seer, the mother-to-be was given the prediction that the child was to be a boy. Unbeknownst to her, her husband had heard news of an unknown evil lurking near the colony, but in his ignorance he chose to ignore it. One night whilst the couple was discussing their future, they and the rest of the Atlantean colony were attacked by the Faceless Ones. Though her husband tried to fight them off, Mara, their unborn child, and the rest of her colony, were murdered. Mara's husband was the sole survivor.
powers: Atlantean Physiology

mara rice.name: Mara Rice
mara rice.origin: Mara Rice was the daughter of famous botanist Professor Rice. During their expedition into the Belgian Congo to collect rare plant samples, they had the unfortunate luck of unknowingly hiring international criminal Red Skelton who would attempt to extort them out of money and force Mara to marry him in exchange for safe passage back home. When Mara's father refused, Red shot him dead. Deciding that he needed all his supplies to get out of the jungle alive, Red attempted to kill Mara, but she was rescued by Ka-Zar who cut Red's throat. Despite Mara wanting to abandon civilization and live with Ka-Zar, the jungle man brought her to a nearby caravan so that she could be taken home.

marada starhair.name: Marada Starhair
marada starhair.species: Human possessing both temporal and arcane power
marada starhair.origin: ===Origins and early years=== Marada Starhair, was the daughter of the first-born daughter of Caesar, and of a foreign prince made a slave in Rome. For some reason, and unbeknownst to her, she possessed both temporal and arcane power. At some point, her mother asked Deiphobë, the Sibylline oracle of Cumae about her daughter, and was told she was unique, which she believed. Marada believed it too for a time. At four years old, Marada saw her father's execution. Despite his torments (broken on the rack, disemboweled, drawn and quartered), he didn't uttered a sound. Marada cried upon her father's death, and would not cry for twenty years afterwards. That very night, Marada's mother fled Rome with her daughter, for her to be raised free, yet a childhood free of innocence. Marada read Julius Caesar's commentaries on his invasion of Britain, including mention of Ashandriar whom he described as a home of the gods. ===Adventures=== Fighting with a ferocious skill that humbled most of the men, she became known as the She-Wolf. ====Europe==== She first met Donal MacLlanllwyr, a friend of her father, near the Rhine, where they battled a war party out of Germanica. They celebrated their victory in a frontier post garrisoned by a cohort of the Thunderclap Legion, matching the legionaries at the drinking, gambling and winning. When a trooper tried to force her to his bed, she broke his jaw, and swore that no man would take her against her will and that she would chose her lover or mate on her terms. Twenty years after fleeing Rome as a child, Marada was a warrior known and respected throughout the Roman Empire, and even beyond, such as in the black empire of Meroë in east Africa. ====Damascus==== Marada led a caravan the length of the Silk Road to Damascus. With the warriors of her escort, they went to a tavern, where Donal was awaiting an opportunity to talk to her. Unfortunately, Marada was drugged and captured by an agent of the immortal sorcerer Simyon Karashnur, who wished to bind Marada's power, both temporal and arcane. Marada was brought to Karashnur's tower and chained within a mystic circle. The sorcerer presented himself to Marada who knew his name, then offered her as consort for the Mabdhara Ygaron of the Triad, who raped her. Ygaron clawed her back in the process, causing massive wounds that he healed with ease. He also removed a part of Marada's soul while replacing it by a part of his, causing Marada to beg for him to stay when he returned to his realm. Karashnur's goal of binding Marada's power was prevented, as she was rescued by agents of the Tribune Gaius Marcellus Fulva, possibly wishing to win Caesar's favor by returning his granddaughter. He organized a caravan, with Parthian mercenaries escorting it, going from Damascus to Rome. Fulva himself was captured by Simyon, and tortured by his Tchunda. ====On the road to Rome==== While in the highlands of Galilee, they were attacked by the soldiers of Ashandriar led by Donal (who intended to find Marada back), prompting the Egyptian driver of Marada's palanquin (possibly an agent of Simyon Karashnur) to attempt to Marada's life, only to be slain by Donal. Donal was astonished seeing the tamed Marada, and returned her and his host to Ashandriar, England, using a spell of transportation. ====Ashandriar==== In Ashandriar, Marada was submissive but wished to leave, prompting Donal to shake her in order to have the She-Wolf return, in vain, only causing her to cry for the first time in twenty years. Using Marada's belongings, Simyon invoked a Reaver, a demon with a piece of the She-Wolf's soul. Marada felt the creation of that evil being, causing a brief panic around her in Ashandriar. She was consequently assigned Donal's daughter Arianrhod as companion. For months, Marada discovered the wonders of childhood, while becoming inseparable with Ari and closer with Donal. While Marada was explaining to Donal her horrible ordeal, the Reaver finally attacked. The demon mortally wounded Donal before retreating with Ari as hostage. Marada was reluctant to go help Ari but forced herself, while Donal died of his wounds. She armed herself with Donal's axe and sword, and the sorceress-queen of Ashandriar Rhiannon transported her to Y'Garon's realm. ====Realm of the Mabdhara==== There, she was quickly confronted by demons and a hellish octopus. Fighting her way into the realm, she reached her goal, the tower where Simyon and Y'Garon waited for her with Ari chained. Marada confronted Y'Garon and bested him, despite Simyon's attempt to subdue her using the scent of conjured magical flowers, avenging herself from the demon. She then slew the sorcerer to avenge Donal. As a swarm of lesser demons were approaching the two, Ari casted a spell of transportation to evade the swampy demonic realm. ====Africa==== Ari and Marada were transported far away from their intended destination, in a ruined temple in a jungle, in southern Africa. fields.notes: Marada, the She-Wolf, was created by writer Chris Claremont and artist John Bolton, and first appeared in (February, 1982). The issues published in Epic Illustrated in 1982 and 1984 were later collected in color in (May, 1986), with a few modifications. Originally the story in was supposed to feature Red Sonja, but Claremont couldn't use her because of the copyright issues surrounding the , so he created Marada and changed the setting of the story.

marandi sjorokker.name: Marandi Sjorokker
marandi sjorokker.first_appearance: Marvel Graphic Novel Vol 1 22: The Amazing Spider-Man: Hooky
marandi sjorokker.origin: Marandi Sjorokker is the daughter of Kurudred the Blood Drinker, a notorious sorcerer from the extra-dimensional realm of Cloudsea. When she was a child, her father's enemies defeated him, drawing a death rune on his forehead. Knowing that his enemies feared that his daughter might eventually grow up to be as evil as he, Kurundred used the last of his power to cast a spell upon her that would freeze her ageing. For over two hundred years, Marandi remained a twelve year old girl. She spent her time exploring other dimensions, spending significant amounts of time on Earth. During this period, she adopted numerous identities, being adopted by many human families until they noticed she didn't age. During one such visit to Earth, she delivered newspapers in Peter Parker's neighborhood, and met his uncle, Ben Parker. Eventually, she returned to Cloudsea, where she found herself being constantly attacked by the Tordenkakerlakk – a giant cockroach-like monster that seemed to grow in power after every defeat. Fearing it had been created by her father's enemies as a final curse against his family, and unable to destroy it on her own, she returned to Earth to seek help. In New York, she met Spider-Man, who she recognised as Peter due to his aura, and convinced him to return to her dimension. The two of them fought the Tordenkakerlakk, but to no avail, with the creature growing larger and more powerful until it had become an immense dragon-like creature. Spider-Man convinced Marandi that if she unleashed her full power, she could defeat the creature. By using all of her magical energy, she was able to destroy it, causing it to dissipate. Spider-Man revealed that he had realised that the creature was, in fact, a creation of her father, intended to force her to overcome her limitations, and that now it was dead, the spell he had placed upon her was broken and she would once again age and mature naturally.

fields.history: Marandi Sjorokker is the daughter of Kurudred the Blood Drinker, a notorious sorcerer from the extra-dimensional realm of Cloudsea. When she was a child, her father's enemies defeated him, drawing a death rune on his forehead. Knowing that his enemies feared that his daughter might eventually grow up to be as evil as he, Kurundred used the last of his power to cast a spell upon her that would freeze her ageing. For over two hundred years, Marandi remained a twelve year old girl. She spent her time exploring other dimensions, spending significant amounts of time on Earth. During this period, she adopted numerous identities, being adopted by many human families until they noticed she didn't age. During one such visit to Earth, she delivered newspapers in Peter Parker's neighborhood, and met his uncle, Ben Parker. Eventually, she returned to Cloudsea, where she found herself being constantly attacked by the Tordenkakerlakk – a giant cockroach-like monster that seemed to grow in power after every defeat. Fearing it had been created by her father's enemies as a final curse against his family, and unable to destroy it on her own, she returned to Earth to seek help. In New York, she met Spider-Man, who she recognised as Peter due to his aura, and convinced him to return to her dimension. The two of them fought the Tordenkakerlakk, but to no avail, with the creature growing larger and more powerful until it had become an immense dragon-like creature. Spider-Man convinced Marandi that if she unleashed her full power, she could defeat the creature. By using all of her magical energy, she was able to destroy it, causing it to dissipate. Spider-Man revealed that he had realised that the creature was, in fact, a creation of her father, intended to force her to overcome her limitations, and that now it was dead, the spell he had placed upon her was broken and she would once again age and mature naturally.

transportation: Marandi had a magical ship, the Nonesuch, that was able to fly at incredibly fast speeds and obeyed her commands, as it had intelligence of its own.

marc antony.name: Marc Antony
marc antony.origin: In 41, B.C. Marc Antony, one of the triumvirs, was given the Eastern sphere of the Roman Empire to rule. There, he met and fell in love with Cleopatra, the Queen of Egypt, who was also a consort of Julius Caesar during his life. Despite marrying Octavius's sister Octavia, Antony continued to lust after Cleopatra. This led to war with Octavius, which Antony lost, in part because Cleopatra withdrew her fleet at a crucial moment. Aware that Antony was furious with her, Cleopatra sent him false news that she had killed herself because of him. Thus convinced of her love, Antony fell on his sword to join her in death. Hearing of this, Cleopatra commited suicide by allowing herself to be bitten by a poisonous asp. He was played on TV by .

marc riemer.name: Marc Riemer
marc riemer.origin: ===Captain America=== Australian criminal Boomslang was ordered by the Viper (Madame Hydra) to infiltrate the Serpent Society. While not a particularly ruthless villain, Boomslang had an incredible throwing arm and excellent hand-to-hand combat skills, which made him a formidable opponent for the likes of Captain America. During his first mission, Boomslang joined Cobra and Copperhead as they poisoned Washington, D.C.'s water supply, turning the citizens into horrifying snake-like creatures. He and Copperhead were quickly dispatched by Captain America, but Cobra managed to escape. During a mission that set the Serpent Society against the X-Men, Boomslang battled Wolverine. Boomslang continued to serve with the Society, but when he was sent to spy on Diamondback, he was confronted by Captain America. Boomslang quickly fled, but ran into a gang of teenage thugs. The gang shot Boomslang numerous times, and Captain America immediately took him to the hospital. Having survived his gunshot wounds, Boomslang returned to a life of crime, attending an A.I.M. Weapons Expo. Boomslang was not seen for several years. However, he resurfaced with the Serpent Society when the original Viper took over leadership and rebranded the organization as Serpent Solutions. With Serpent Solutions, Boomslang fought the new Captain America and Falcon. He later joined Baron Helmut Zemo's Army of Evil during Secret Empire. Alongside other Serpent Society members, Boomslang was hired by Constrictor (unbeknownst to the Society, actually Frank Payne's son) to help steal Iron Fist's Book of the Iron Fist. The Serpent Society then clashed with Iron Fist, Sabretooth, Choshin, and Choshin's henchmen. ===Hunted=== Boomslang was among several animal-themed super-villains captured by Taskmaster and Black Ant to serve as hunting targets for Kraven the Hunter and Arcade. Boomslang was presumably apprehended alongside other Serpent Society members who had been captured when the force field keeping the villains inside Central Park went down. ===Criminal Technology Show Expo=== Boomslang, with several other members of the Serpent Society, attended the Criminal Technology Show Expo. Boomslang and his teammates went to the restroom where they were ambushed by M.O.D.O.K. and beaten to near death. Iron Man, working with M.O.D.O.K., suggested they hide the villains before they regain consciousness. King Cobra later discovered them and alerted the rest of the supervillains of M.O.D.O.K.'s and Iron Man's presence. ===Devil's Reign=== At some point, Boomslang was imprisoned in the super-criminal private prison known as the Myrmidon. Boomslang participated in a combat tournament held by the prison guards. His first opponent was Moon Knight, who quickly defeated Boomslang. ===Serpent's Tears=== Boomslang, along with the rest of the reorganized Serpent Society, were tasked by Viper, who renamed himself Pit Viper, to gather components for the return of Mephisto. During an argument with new recruit Tiger Snake, Boomslang was apparently crushed to death by Pit Viper's latest recruit Titanoboa. However he later showed up alive and joined the Serpent Society's final heist at Attania.
abilities: Skilled Combatant: Boomslang is an excellent hand-to-hand combatant. Throwing: Boomslang is skilled in the use of throwing weapons.
weapons: Boomslang throws snake-shaped sickles he calls his "serpent-rangs."

marcel fournier.name: Marcel Fournier
marcel fournier.origin: Marcel Fournier was a French Canadian trapper and spy who was operating as an agent of the Canadian government in 1885 to try and beat a number of other nations in finding a mountain filled with above-ground crude oil in Alaska. The mountain was incredibly important as it possessed so much easily accessible oil that whoever held it could easily dominate the world economy. Fournier was nearly hanged for killing rival agents in self-defense, but the Two-Gun Kid rescued him, faking Matt Hawk's death in the process. The pair soon joined forces with an Apache warrior named Running Fish and a renegade samurai named Hijiro Nguri in order to locate and destroy this mountain. The group succeeded in eluding their pursuers and blowing up the mountain. Seemingly killed, the group actually survived the blast and remained together for a time as the Sunset Riders. The quartet soon drifted apart. But Fournier later asked for the Two-Gun Kid's help to defend the town of Wonderment from corrupt businessman Clay Riley's Nightriders. During the siege of Wonderment, Fournier was exposed as Riley's double agent and the Two-Gun Kid was forced to kill him.
abilities: Marcel Fournier was an incredibly skilled fur trapper and woodsman. He was also a good hand-to-hand combatant as well as a decent shot and horseman.
affiliations: Double agent for Clay Riley's Nightriders

marcella callasantos.name: Marcella Callasantos
marcella callasantos.origin: Marcella Callasantos was the mother of Maria and Lucia Callasantos, the mutant sisters known as Feral and Thornn. After the birth of her fourth daughter, Marcella's husband left the family leaving Marcella and her children in misery. Later Marcella became attached to a bad man who initiated her to alcohol and drugs. When Marcella's boyfriend attempted to sexually take advantage of Lucia, Maria attacked him thanks to her emerging mutant powers and killed him. Realizing what her daughter had done, Marcella retaliated by killing the only things she cared about Maria, or her pigeons. In an uncontrollable fury, Maria killed her mother with her own claws.

marcella carson.origin: Marcella Carson was the daughter of Mr. Carson, the owner of Carson Carnival, the carnival where Hawkeye worked as a performer before he became a superhero. After her father retired, she took over running the carnival. However, it was then forcibly taken over by Taskmaster and used as a mobile training ground. marcello montesi.name: Marcello Montesi
marcello montesi.origin: Marcello was the grandson of Paolo Montesi, the monk Pope Eugene III tasked with translating the Darkhold. His grandfather had been granted a special dispensation by the Pope to marry and father children as the Pope wanted the Darkhold book protected by Paolo's descendants. Marcello's grandfather Paolo was killed by Varnae, the first vampire, to keep the church from uncovering a formula to destroy all vampires. When Marcello's father Giacomo Montesi traveled to Tibet in search of this formula, he was killed by one of Varnae's human agents. Eventually, Varnae tracked Marcello down and killed him as well, but not before appointing Dracula as the new leader of the vampires. Throughout the ages Montesi's descendants waged war on the vampires.

marci stahl.origin: Marci Stahl was a lawyer working for the prestigious firm Landman and Zack, and dated Foggy Nelson while he and Matt Murdock were interns there. marcia guzman.name: Marcia Guzman
marcia guzman.origin: Marcia Guzman was a law student who signed up for a prenatal calcium experiment not knowing that the experiment was actually a cover by Angela Golden, Dr. Malus, and Dr. Forrest to create various types of Super-Soldiers. Guzman was one of only 6% of the test subjects to survive with powers. When Guzman and the other survivors of the experiment went on the run, they were hunted down by Golden. Guzman changed her name to "Alicia". The survivors stole a experimental prototype armor from a private research facility in Estonia that they used between themselves, sharing the identity of Trace, in order to fight back. While investigating the murder of Tulio, Marcia's brother who had been murdered while searching for his missing sister, the Avenger Hawkeye (Clint Barton) found and joined with Marcia and the other survivors in order to help them fight back against those chasing them. thumb|left|270px|Guzman changing her muscle mass
powers: Dr. Forrest's experiment gave Guzman the ability to bulk up her muscle mass in order to increase her speed and strength.

marcia hastings.name: Marcia Hastings
marcia hastings.origin: The Western Kid, his horse Whirlwind and dog Lightning come pass by the old man Hastings' Spread and witness the elderly crippled and his family being pressured by their ranch hand, Bart Carter, to give him half the profits from the sale of cattle he has been hired to move. Carter has also demanded that Mr. Hastings allow him to marry his granddaughter Marcia. Despite the fact that she loves Pete Lane, Marcia is willing to go through with the deal in order to save her father from losing money on his cattle. With Hastings being forced to agree to the deal, the Western Kid tells the old man that he will try to do something to get the old man out of his situation, however Carter warns his men to be vigilant as he suspects that Tex Dawson will try something. Tex first rides over to Peter Lane's home and tells him to go and keep an eye on Marcia while he handles the situation. As the Kid rides off he suspects that greedy Bart Carter will try to find a way to claim all the profits from the sale of cattle and will attempt to change the branding on the cattle to his own. To try and catch him in this act, the Western Kid attempts to start a stampede of the longhorns, but is knocked out by Carter and his men. When Tex comes around he finds himself and Whirlwind tied up and Lightning missing, presumed dead in the stampede. However, Lightning survived and while Carter and his men prepare to rebrand one of the cattle, Lightning attacks while Whirlwind chews through his master's bonds. He then makes short work of Carter and his men, turn them over to the authorities and sells the cattle for Hasting. He then returns to the Hasting's ranch with the full amount of money. While Mr. Hasting is happy to have his money, Marcia in turn agrees to marry Pete Lane.

marcia kenwell.name: Marcia Kenwell
marcia kenwell.origin: Marcia Kenwell was an ordinary-looking woman who lived in New York. She had an almost obsessive hatred for cockroaches, as well as foreigners, who she blamed for the filth in the city that attracted insects. One night, she awoke from a restless sleep to find her own apartment filled with roaches. In a panic, she screamed at them, telling them to go away, and to her surprise, they obeyed. Testing her powers, she realized she could communicate with the roaches, and ordered them to go to the apartment of her immigrant neighbors and devour them. When she heard the screams, she decided to celebrate with a drink, but found more cockroaches in her cupboard. She realized she could read their thoughts, and that the swarm of roaches were all telling her that they loved her. Oddly touched by the affection, she responded by telling them that she loved them too, and ordered them to come to her. At her command, every roach in the city came towards her, apparently smothering her. She only had time to scream once.
powers: Marcia Kenwell had the ability to communicate with cockroaches and read their thoughts. It is unclear if her powers allowed her to directly control them, or if they simply loved her enough to willingly follow her commands.

marcia pearson.name: Marcia Pearson
marcia pearson.origin: thumb|left Marcy Peason caught the eye of Tony Stark and he soon hired her as Public Relations Chief of Stark Enterprises shortly after the new company opened on the west coast. Marcy also quickly caught the eye of Jim Rhodes and the two began dating. Marcy was overly ambitious and career-driven in the end, however. When Tony Stark was presumed dead and Rhodey followed him as CEO, Marcy attempted to use her relationship with Jim to acquire more power for herself, and push SE in the direction she wanted. Rhodes ended up firing Marcy and ending their relationship as he asserted his authority. As a result Marcy sought revenge against both Stark and Rhodes. She used a computer hacker named Raven to leak information about dirty dealings performed by Stane International, a recently acquired subsidiary of Stark Enterprises. Marcy's corporate espionage was eventually uncovered, and Stark turned her over to the authorities.

marcia trent.name: Marcia Trent
marcia trent.origin: Marcia Trent's father was a famous archeologist and, together, they uncovered many ancient sites. In their final dig together, they discovered an ancient Assyrian temple to the god Ningal. Her father removed a particularly impressive statue of the god, and arranged to have it shipped to London. Ningal killed her father for his act of blasphemy, while Marcia made a pact with the god – by providing victims and sacrifices, Ningal would spare her life. To seal the pact, Ningal took her shadow. As an agent of Ningal, Marcia lured innocent victims to the statue, convincing them that she had been cursed by the god and needed their help to regain her shadow. Eventually, Marcia became engaged to Murdoch Adams, an enemy of Ningal. She drugged his wine and attempted to murder him. However, before he passed out, he used a magical talisman which broke Ningal's hold over her and also resulted in her death.

marcie miller.name: Marcie Miller
marcie miller.origin: Marcie was a police officer who alongside her partner, Russ Parker, responded to a shooting and discovered the Punisher who they tried to arrest, they were disarmed with ease while the Punisher escaped them. A dirty cop, Detective Stu Westin was told to find the Punisher and had Marcie and Russ faked injuries at a press conference to rile up the media and their fellow officers to seek the Punisher's arrest much to Russ and especially Marcie's chagrin and derision. When Marcie and Russ heard that another officer had found himself in a similar position they approached him hoping to unravel the reason behind the lies which led to them being assaulted by seven other officers in the locker room in what was made to seem like a homophobic attack aimed at Russ. Marcie and Russ were given a week off and the official line was that they had fallen down the stairs, Russ still suspected Westin's involvement and convinced Marcie to see what they could learn and to fight back. Together they tracked down Jennifer Cooke a social worker who had met the Punisher in the past and whom he had chosen to help him get the information he needed and help the victims of sex trafficking he came across. When the Punisher called Jennifer to warn her she might be in danger Marcie and Russ told her what to say in an attempt to get the Punisher to meet with her. Russ had come up with a plan to arrest the Punisher which Marcie was unsure would work but which she ultimately agreed to. The Punisher had figured out they would be attending the meeting and that they were doing it without the backing of the NYPD and attended to see what they wanted. They revealed what they had learned about Westin on their week off including that he was using another dirty cop to surveil Jennifer which led them to the Punisher who they made a deal with, they wouldn't interfere with him taking out the slavers as long as they got dirt on Westin and were the ones to arrest him. This situation bothered Marcie more than it did Russ. Marcie was still unsure of working with the Punisher but Russ pointed out it might help them make detective, Marcie then pointed out that taking down a cop, even a corrupt one, might do the opposite. Russ told her she could walk away but Marcie told him she couldn't and wouldn't do that. When they still hadn't heard from the Punisher Marcie went to see Jennifer who told her more about her work with trafficked women and what the slavers did. After that particular slaver ring was shut down Marcie quit the police force and went to work for Jennifer Cooke as a social worker, trying to shut down the traffickers as best they could.

marcios.name: Marcios
marcios.origin: Marcios was a soldier, one of the Guards of Khauran. He was loyal to Taramis, Queen of Khauran. One day, Constantius, an exiled mercenary, led his army through the lands of Khauran asking to pass over to reach Turan. He was secretly allied with Salome, twin-sister of Taramis. Taramis accepted to let the army pass through Khauran but she had Constantius confined in the southern tower, until his Shemite mercenaries had passed the borders with Turan. That night Salome, impersonating her sister, let the Shemite mercenaries enter the town. She also freed Constantius from his prison. Marcios was not in service when the Shemites entered in the city. A sergeant found him, and with all the soldiers he had to assemble outside the Royal Palace. So, Marcios was present when Salome, impersonating Taramis, accepted Constantius' marriage proposal, and released the Khauran army. He saw Conan, a Captain of the Guards, accusing Salome of being a false Taramis, and when the Shemites attacked Conan, Marcios flanked him and the other Khauran soldiers, but they were outnumbered by the Shemites and they were killed or fled. Conan was captured. Marcios was wounded but managed to flee. Marcios hid in the house of Ivga, his woman. He was sure that Taramis had betrayed her people. Conan was condemned to death on the cross. In the following months, Marcios changed his idea. He saw Taramis, still impersonated by Salome, marry Constantius, the people of Khauran heavily taxed, vexed and humiliated. Many young Khaurans were sold as slaves to the Turanians. After that Salome started to worship unnamed demons and slaying innocent people for human sacrifices. Marcios was convinced of the same idea of Conan, that the Queen was not Taramis but a witch. Marcios told his suspects to Astreas, a historian. Then, he organized a revolt. But it failed and Marcios had to flee and hide again. A night of seven months after Salome's arrival, Marcios, disguised as a deaf-mute, saw Khumbanigash and Salome going out form a prison. He heard them speaking about Taramis, and learned about her real situation. Salome noticed him, but saw only a deaf-mute, and gave him the head of Krallides, counselor of the Queen, known by Marcios. Khumbanigash ordered him to go away. A week after, Conan, having survived the cross and now leader of more than 11,000 Zuagir warriors, headed to Khauran with his nomads, plus a secret battalion of 3,000 Hyborian knights of Khauran. Meanwhile Marcios had organized the liberation of Taramis from the prison, using the chaos resulting from the coming battle and the few presence of Shemite troops in the city. Attalus and other men agreed to help him. The Zuagirs and the Hyborian defeated the Shemite mercenaries. Marcios sneaked into the prisons and found Conan fighting Zinn, one of Salome's slaves. Salome was killing Taramis then Marcios jumped over Salome and stabbed the witch with her sword. He extracted the sword from her body but she didn't die. Conan transported Taramis outside the temple, Marcios followed him, but Salome was still alive. With her last whispers she recalled her demon, Thaug, then died. Marcios brought Taramis far from the demon, while Conan tried to stop the monster. Helped by and the Zuagir Desert Wolves Conan killed Thaug. Taramis was the Queen again. She offered to Conan to become Captain again and also to become her counselor, but Conan preferred to be the leader of the Zuagirs; then Taramis claimed Marcios new Captain of the Guards.

marcos diaz.name: Marcos Diaz
marcos diaz.origin: Marcos Diaz, also known by the alias "Eclipse", is an operative of the Mutant Underground. Eclipse, his girlfriend Polaris, and Thunderbird rescued Blink from the Atlanta PD after she escaped from prison. They got Blink to the Underground's headquarters, but Polaris was arrested during the rescue. While he was coming up with a plan to break Polaris out of jail, he was contacted by Reed Strucker. Reed offered to use his position in the Atlanta District Attorney's office to help Polaris if the Underground smuggled his family to Mexico after he and his wife Caitlin discovered their children Lauren and Andy were both mutants. He also told Eclipse that Polaris was pregnant. Eclipse and the Struckers were ambushed by the Sentinel Services when he met with the family to get them across the border. Fortunately, Thunderbird and Blink tracked Eclipse in case something like this happened and helped them run from the Sentinel Services. Blink opened a portal to the Underground's headquarters before the Sentinel Services had them cornered. Eclipse and the rest escaped to safety, but Blink could not hold the portal open long enough for Reed to get through when an agent of the Sentinel Services shot him in the leg.
weaknesses: It cannot absorb light from places like sewers.

marcos runnemyer.name: Marcos Runnemyer
marcos runnemyer.species: Mutated when organ thieves left a power source in his chest
marcos runnemyer.origin: ===Civil War=== Following the Stamford disaster, US officials immediately developed the Superhuman Registration Act, outlawing any crimefighting activities by unregistered super heroes, including Runnemyer. Having no objection to registration itself, but distrusting the S.R.A., Marcos joined the Anti-Registration Underground led by Network since he entrusted the decision to fate and declined to register because he interpreted his Daily Globe horoscope as advice against doing so. He was present when S.H.I.E.L.D. raided the safehouse and was among the rebels arrested. While remaining in Prison 42 to await prosecution, Runnemyer went on to consult with the Daily Bugle, the New York Star, and the East Village Oracle. Given the advice to register, Haunter did so at the first opportunity, received amnesty, and was released without incident. He continued to remain neutral during the Civil War between those that supported the Superhuman Registration Act and those who continued to oppose it. Despite the differences, Runnemyer resumed dividing his time between heroic activities and spiritual endeavors.

marcus andrews.name: Marcus Andrews
marcus andrews.origin: Rem-Ram was born somewhere in Belgium. Rem-Ram was a member of the Acolytes. When Fabian Cortez ordered an attack on Xavier's mansion Rem-Ram was assigned to enter Rogue's dreams, allowing her to touch a man without absorbing his thoughts and feelings. In fact, she had touched Magneto – and even accepted a diamond ring from him – before being jarred out of her sleep by Gambit. When Fabian Cortez forced Rem-Ram to invade the conscious Professor X's mind, Rem-Ram failed. Fabian fled, leaving Rem-Ram and the remaining Acolytes on the grounds of the estate to seek asylum from the X-Men. Professor X refused them, after having been burned by attempting to rehabilitate Sabretooth. Rem-Ram was killed in the Wild Sentinels' attack on Genosha. He was among several of the Acolytes' whose bodies were reanimated by the Collective. However, he was later resurrected by the Transmode Virus from Selene, along with some other Acolytes.

marcus arlington iii.name: Marcus Arlington III
marcus arlington iii.origin: Marcus Arlington III was a doctor at the Empire State Hospital. When Jam got in a motorcycle accident she was taken to the Hospital, and Arlington was her doctor. Here he first met Nate Grey and gained a healing power. When Arlington touched Jam he, to his own surprise, regrow her lost arm. To make sure that it was he who did it, Arlington came to see another patient, and healed his bullet wound. After that, he briefly lived in the Nate Grey's Loft in SoHo, together with Nate, Jam, Bux, Rita, and Roust. When Nate left the city, Arlington, with Roust and his brother Joust went on a journey around the world, using his newly gained power to save lives.

marcus coriander.name: Marcus Coriander
marcus coriander.origin: Marcus Coriander was a small-time bookkeeper in Chicago, later moving to Park Avenue South and ordering the Punishment Squad to kill Manhattan mob bosses two months later. Although originally wanting the Punisher to lead the Punishment Squad, he later wanted him dead and was irritated that not one of them could find him and had them practice shooting on cardboard cutouts of him. Then, the Punisher, who had been there for hours, confronted him in his office, held him at gunpoint, and insisted that someone had helped him organize the Punishment Squad and attempt to take over the mobs, although Coriander claimed that he was on the Punisher's side and that they did more to smash the mobs in one week than he was able to do in his whole life. Coriander knew that the Punisher didn't really kill the Kingpin and declared that killing him would make the crime boss more powerful than ever, but as the vigilante was prepared to kill him, he attacked him with a lamp before running away, ordering the Punishment Squad to help him, and rushing into an elevator. He stopped in an alley, where the Punisher found him and told him that it was Alaric's idea to take over the gangs and turn them to his uses. Then, Coriander was shot dead by Angela.

marcus devane.name: Marcus Devane
marcus devane.origin: Morelle Pharmaceuticals representative Marcus Devane was assigned to military research project Project: Sandstorm alongside ESU scientist Dr. Marla Madison. Incensed over the Daily Bugle's expose on Project: Sandstorm, Devane accused Madison of leaking information to her husband J. Jonah Jameson, and ordered her grad student Tony Trainer to begin their experiment with bio-samples from Quicksand and the Sandman. Despite Madison's intentions to conduct the experiment in the desert, Trainer proceeded. The bio-samples made contact, resulting in an explosion that mutated Trainer and killed Devane. In the confusion, Trainer believed that he had killed Devane.

marcus gallio.name: Marcus Gallio
marcus gallio.origin: ===Early Life=== Marcus was born into the ancient lineage of the Gallio family, steeped in the rich traditions of the lost Roman colony of Nova Roma settled in the Amazon Jungle of Brazil. From his earliest days, Marcus was surrounded by the echoes of a bygone era, with tales of valor and conquest woven into the fabric of his upbringing. Marcus harbored a secret yearning for power—a desire that would shape the course of his destiny. As he matured into adulthood, his ambitions grew ever more fervent, driving him to seek out opportunities to assert his dominance and carve out his place in the city. Becoming a Senator Marcus crossed paths with the enigmatic Selene, a woman of otherworldly beauty and unfathomable power. Drawn to her like a moth to flame, Marcus fell under her spell, unaware of the depths of deceit that lay beneath her captivating façade. ===New Mutants=== Senator Gallio strategically maneuvered within the Nova Roma, to consolidate power within the government. In his pursuit, he cultivated silent adversaries, notably his rival Senator Lucius Aquilla. His ambition for power surged when he identified an opportunity with the capture of four young mutants: Cannonball, Danielle Moonstar, Sunspot, and Wolfsbane the friends of the exiled daughter of his rival Amara Aquilla. While in the Senatorial baths, Senator Gallio was intercepted by Senator Aquila, who halted him mid-stride as he received a massage. Their conversation pivoted to the revelation of the captured outlanders, stunning Gallio with Aquila's knowledge. Aquila advocated for using the male captives in the arena, a proposition that stirred Gallio's strategic mind. Returning to Selene, she proposed eliminating Aquila, but Gallio declined, opting to handle the matter himself. Following Selene's lead, Gallio descended beneath their villa, discovering another captive named Castro. Recognizing the potential for wealth through Castro's connections with external realms, Gallio's ambition surged. Meanwhile, Selene orchestrated the sedation of the female captives Danielle, Wolfsbane, and Senator Aquila's daughter. Forced to watch from Gallio's side, the girls witnessed Cannonball and Sunspot's victorious display in the coliseum. In a calculated move to quell potential unrest, Gallio publicly declared the four mutants as the children of the gods, solidifying his authority amidst the crowd's reactions. Driven by his thirst for power and aspirations of emperorship, Gallio orchestrated a grand parade for the mutants, followed by an elaborate feast where he sought to entice them with promises of power and glory by his side. He skilfully manipulated the mutants, painting Aquila as their common enemy who harbored ambitions of becoming emperor. In a bid to tighten his grip over them, Gallio orchestrated a staged assassination attempt on the mutants, with Castro playing the role of the attacker. When Castro was apprehended, he falsely implicated Senator Aquila in the plot. Gallio wasted no time dispatching his soldiers to either capture or eliminate Aquila. However, the mutants intervened, saving Aquila from Gallio's clutches, much to the latter's silent frustration. Despite Senator Aquila's rescue, he was still unjustly detained, thanking the young heroes for their help. Senator Gallio dispatched his soldiers in search of Danielle, disregarding their suggestion that Selene might have her. When Aquila dared to oppose him, Gallio swiftly silenced him by ordering another guard to strike him down. Perceiving Cannonball as a threat, Gallio commanded his soldiers to poison him and administer a slave potion to Wolfsbane. However, before they could carry out his orders, Amara, whose mutant abilities had awakened, burst through the floor, liberating Senator Aquila. As chaos erupted, with enemies including the Nova Romans traitors—joining the fray, a full-scale conflict ensued between them and Gallio's forces. Betrayed by the mutants, Gallio found himself confronted by their united front. In a desperate attempt to regain control, he personally incapacitated Wolfsbane. Engaging in combat with Senator Aquila, Gallio believed victory was within his grasp, only to meet his demise when Aquila fatally struck him through the heart with a sword.

marcus glove.name: Marcus Glove
marcus glove.origin: 200px|left|thumb|Marcus Glove in New York City during the Inferno ===Origin=== Marcus Glove was just an average man until he was caught in the crossfire when Magik brought Hell to New York City during the Inferno. Later when Onslaught attempted to ignite a sun in Central Park, Marcus lost a leg and his wife when a tree fell on them. While recovering in Alaska, Marcus lost an arm and an eye when crushed by debris from Master Mold after the Sentinel was shot down by Cyclops' optic blast. Hoping to escape further mutant-related violence, Marcus moved out to San Francisco. Unfortunately, during the final confrontation between the Avengers and the X-Men, Marcus was burned by an errant Phoenix-fire, which resulting in him losing his remaining limbs and covering a large portion of his body in burn tissue. Despite all of this, Marcus never developed any hatred toward mutants. He just believed that something has to be done. ===I.B.S.S.=== Becoming genuinely concerned the mutants will destroy the world, Marcus Glove became a superstar spokesperson with the simple message "Something has to be done". Through this message he secured funding through a dozen book deals, a cable channel, questions in the senate and hobnobbing in the U.N. Unlike other "anti-mutant" campaigners and other such extremist, he was reasonable, restrained, and caring. Just stating the facts, which was something has to be done. Gathering specialists from dozens of scientific disciplines and organized the Institute of Bio-Social Studies headquarters in San Francisco. The I.B.S.S. became a charitable organization founding research, a hospital, public relations, and developing a pharmaceutical cure to mutantism called X-Cise. However, David eventually discovered that Marcus was brain dead for quite some time. The man was a puppet under the control of the Red Skull, like many others in the Institute. Marcus decided in the struggle against a squad of X-Men gathered to rescue Legion. The Red Skull intended to use Marcus as a martyr, but the intervention of Legion's "friend" nipped this plan in the bud.

marcus kang xxiii.name: Marcus Kang XXIII
marcus kang xxiii.origin: ===Kang Dynasty=== Kang the Conqueror appeared with his son Marcus, the new Scarlet Centurion and showed many visions of the Earth's possible futures, all of them dark and horrific. At first it was thought he intended to help the Earth, but then he announced that he wished to conquer it in order to save it. Kang told the UN that he would strike at France first- he wished them to be prepared. He then cunningly split his enemies by announcing that any who conquered land in his name would have a place in his new order. Several groups and foes- including The Presence, the Deviants, and Attuma's Atlanteans, attacked across the world. Kang knew that against an invading army the Earth would unite but against their own, they would be fractured. After these attacks were beaten off, Kang launched his invasion of Europe with his army from the far future. The Avengers and UN troops fought back valiantly at the ramparts they had constructed, while the American forces were occupied with an attack by the self-proclaimed Master of The World, who created technological towers capable of resisting Kang around all major North American cities. Warbird finally managed to kill him- and was helped personally by Kang's son, the Scarlet Centurion Marcus, who was infatuated with her. The Avengers tried to infiltrate Kang's starship, Damocles Base. Meanwhile, beginning to wrapping up a long-running plotline, the Avengers discovered that the religious cult known as the Triune Understanding was trying to protect Earth from a mysterious threat named the Triple Evil. After the attack failed, the Avengers who had launched the attack- including Captain America- were stranded in space. Kang seized control of the Sentinel Fleet the US planned to protect themselves with, and used a futuristic weapon to devastate Washington DC and kill millions. With the threat of more such attacks, the world had no choice but to surrender to Kang- with the Wasp personally doing so for the Avengers. Kang had finally succeeded in conquering Earth. On Earth, Kang and the Scarlet Centurion were gloating over their victory when they were told the Avengers were attacking their main prison. Thor and the Avengers left on Earth freed Wasp and many other heroes, taking them to the Master's base, which they had found and were using as their own new base of operations. They had discovered how to activate his technology- the huge ring-walls- across America, which would prove a massive threat to Kang. Their plan was to distract him so that Warbird, Thor, Iron Man, Wonder Man, and Firestar could attack Damocles Base, with the Master's technology hopefully taking down its protective force field. Wasp had reservations until the President himself, who was safely at the base, encouraged her to do it. She said that first she had to make some calls. Meanwhile, Captain America's team in space made for Earth, using the Pyramid's power. On Earth, Kang declared that he would destroy a city each hour until the Avengers who had broken open the prison surrendered once more. However, even as he did the Master's technological towers erupted from the ground and attacked. Thanks to Jan's calls, across the world others assaulted Kang's forces- including The Presence, the Atlanteans and the Deviants. marcus kumar.name: Marcus Kumar
marcus kumar.origin: Marc Kumar was a freelancer P.R. and marketing expert who met Pepper Potts in Las Vegas, during Tony Stark's absence in space, while he was handling a drunk client at a party Pepper was attending. After dating for months, Marc proposed to Pepper in Scotland. From the stories Pepper told him about Stark, Marc came to the conclusion that he treated her badly, and grew resentful at Tony. thumb|left|As the Liar Following Tony's return from space, he hired Marc to work for Stark Industries' P.R. area, and organized the ceremony for the inauguration of the Core at Stark's Troy City. Shortly after that, Marc was given the Liar ring of the Mandarin due the secret hate he harbored towards Stark. He joined other Mandarins in fighting Malekith the Accursed after the Dark Elf began to steal the rings from other bearers. He kept working with the remaining Mandarins in Mole Man's plan to create ring-powered weapons to destroy cities from their base in Sinister London. When Iron Man, the Trojan Guard, Abigail Burns and Iron Patriot pinned them down, Marc revealed his identity as the Liar to Tony, and attempted to escape, creating an illusion of Pepper Potts to use as collateral. Having seen through Marc's illusion, Iron Man called his bluff and grazed Marc with a repulsor blast that went through the phantasmal Pepper. Marc's ring was taken from him, and he was hospitalized in a high-security S.H.I.E.L.D. hospital. Pepper later visited him to return her engagement ring to him, claiming that she didn't need saving, and that even though Tony had treated her bad, at most times he didn't.
powers: None

marcus lyman.name: Marcus Lyman
marcus lyman.origin: ===Early Life=== thumb|150px|left|Marcus prior to the Accident Marcus and his wife were accidentally harmed during an attack on his Wall Street trading company for losing a client's money. Marcus survived, but his wife did not. Shrapnel was fixed within his brain, causing him to feel virtually no human connection whatsoever. ===The Walking Massacre=== With his new lease on life, he escaped an institution and began killing people, eventually even shooting Spider-Man, who had lost his spider-sense at the time. He was ultimately defeated when Spider-Man used a combination of a bullet-proof suit and magnetic webbing. Spider-Man saved his life from the police, because of his new "No One Dies" policy after the death of Marla Jameson. Following his arrest, he was placed in Ravencroft Institute. However, he soon escaped, killing Dr. Ashley Kafka in the process. He ended up confronting the CEO of a restaurant and he gave her an offer - 12 million dollars to go into New York City and kill people while wearing the logo of her competitor, which she was forced to accept. Otto Octavius, now Spider-Man, was able to track him to Grand Central Station and managed to save the rest of the civilians, take his gun, shoot him in the shoulder, and hold him at gunpoint. Having the man who once told him that he wouldn't let anyone else die hold him at gunpoint caused Massacre to tear up and experience fear for the first time since his accident, finding the feeling wonderful. Despite Peter's persona begging Otto to spare him, the Superior web-slinger pulled the trigger, putting an end to the mass murderer once and for all. ===Dead No More=== However, almost a year later, the Jackal brought Massacre and numerous other Spider-Man villains back to life. For some reason, though New U was supposed to revive individuals without any defects, Marcus presumedly retained the shrapnel in his brain, as he was seen with the metal plate on his head. He also continued to get into fights with some of the other revived villains, such as Kangaroo. Massacre survived after many of the revived villains were killed and at some point was interned at the Myrmidon prison, where he fought Moon Knight in the prison's fighting ring.
powers: Unable to feel emotions for his fellow man, Marcus had no problem killing innocent people.

fields.unusual_features: Shrapnel stuck in his forehead, metal plate on left side of his skull

marcus momplaisir.name: Marcus Momplaisir
marcus momplaisir.first_appearance: Free Comic Book Day 2021: Spider-Man/Venom Vol 1 1
marcus momplaisir.origin: As a representative of the Beyond Corporation, Marcus helped Janine Godbe with her relocation out of prison as a means of ensuring employee loyalty in Ben Reilly, the company's official Spider-Man. Marcus then hired Dr. Ashley Kafka to ensure Ben Reilly's mental well being, and also for her research from Ravencroft in memory extraction. When Ben returned from informing the original Spider-Man of Beyond's ownership of the trademark, Marcus interrupted Ben's telling Janine the details due to legality of not knowing or affiliating with any past Spider-Men. As Ben was tracking the U-Foes, Marcus had him head to R&D for radiation proof equipment as a precaution. After Ben returned and confirm he delivered the original Spider-Man to the hospital for treatment. Marcus was satisfied with the update, and scheduled a session with Dr. Kafka, before Ben received approval from the original Spider-Man and he continued the mission. Keeping up Ben's training with Misty Knight and Colleen Wing, Marcus was worried for him after an encounter with Morbius and approved a weekend off to recuperate. When Ben returned, Marcus's dialogue caused an offense that led to Ben going radio silent before dispatching the Spider-Man to a high priory alert at a Beyond board member's home, Andrew Airs. With Ben disconnected, Marcus and staff worked to find him while being hounded by Janine for answers and Maxine ordering such as well. Thankfully, Marcus reunited with Ben after his abduction by Kraven and got him medical attention before updating Maxine. After sending Ben to battle new supervillain, Rhizome, on a rampage in Bed-Stuy, Marcus advised Ben should he meet the Brooklyn Spider-Man to get him to rename to another spider themed name given Beyond's ownership of the trademark. But from Ben's failure to "enforce" copyright, Marcus was given disciplinary action by Maxine. While promising not to disturb Ben and Janine's date night, Marcus called Ben when Doc Ock attacked Beyond Midtown and successfully stole a coveted Beyond item above his pay grade. Meeting Ben in the Medical Suite, Marcus learned from Maxine the stolen data drive held critical information for Beyond. No time to recover, Marcus directed Ben to Beyond Tower as Doc Ock attacked with aims to revenge upon Maxine, and was shocked by Ben's admission to modifying the glider pack with a turbo thruster. Following Ben's disastrous mission against new supervillain, Hellbomb, Marcus was sent to check on Janine while Ben underwent his scheduled therapy, but was taken hostage and used to exit the building. Although he attempted coded language of the situation, Beyond security still allowed them through and Janine took his money before he returned to be detained by Maxine's orders. Once Janine and the data drive were found, Maxine told him they were at the Daily Bugle before telling Marcus about Jason Halifax to establish context. That said, Marcus was horrified to learn that Beyond was really investing in superheroes as a "solution" to supervillains they covertly create, all part of a long scheme to control the social narrative.
abilities: Businessman: Marcus's comprehension of corporate legalities and loopholes allowed him to release Janine Godbe from prison on the same day he met her, all to ensure Ben Reilly's loyalty.

marcus roston.name: Marcus Roston
marcus roston.origin: ===Early Life=== Marcus Roston is an influential Hollywood actor and also a drug dealer, supplying Heat Pills to the Hollywood elite. ===Daken=== left|thumb Daken tried the Heat pills while attending one of Roston's parties. To his amazement, he found the pills could beat his healing factor, causing him to lose a fight with Roston's guards. After waking up, Daken initiated a sexual relationship with Roston, and demanded to know everything he knew about Los Angeles' crime scene, as well as access to more pills. While it at first seemed that Roston was Daken's patsy, Roston revealed himself to be much more than anyone thought as a major source of Heat pills, not just a user. He was also somehow able to change his appearance to that of Daken's while taunting F.B.I. agent Donna Kiel into believing that the "Claws Killer" terrorizing Hollywood was Daken, when in reality it was Marcus Roston himself.

marcus tsung.name: Marcus Tsung
marcus tsung.origin: Marcus Tsung was born in the Far East as the son of a Chinese witchwoman and a Hungarian physicist. His power manifested early and he used it to form a criminal empire spanning parts of China, India, and Russia. He mostly dealt in drugs and nuclear technology. The Hand attempted to recruit him, but he returned their dead emissary served with Saffron Rice and Rose Tea; he was never bothered by them again. To train himself, he ordered bull elephants pumped full of a potent cocktail of narcotics to make make them stronger, faster, and totally insane. He didn't kill them with his "virtual bullets", but with his bare hands. One day he was gone, walking out on his entire empire. When he resurfaced, he was hired to go after Domino. Upon entering the United States he killed all of his employer's underlings who knew his name before beginning his mission. He was able to find Domino, despite her elaborate disguise and relocation. In a battle between X-Force and Domino, Tsung easily and systematically defeated each of its members until a sneak attack by Tabitha (Meltdown). Although thought dead, he got back up and attempted to kill her only to be taken down by Romany Wisdom's (Pete Wisdom's sister) snipers.
powers: Murder Gene: The "Murder Gene" enables him to create "virtual bullets" that do not affect inanimate objects, but can pierce, damage, and detonate the organic matter found within living things.

He was also a public figure, renovating deteriorated buildings in Detroit. At some point, Marcus met Zack Starr; who he became very fond of and had; made Zack his familiar. When Marcus had later discovered that; Zack was a spy working for Blade, he had him killed. This had initially earned him the hatred of the latter's twin sister, Krista Starr. Krista had tried to kill Marcus as revenge for murdering her brother; but she had failed and was captured; by Chase. Instead of having Krista killed, Marcus become smitten; with her and had turned her; into a vampire.

marcus wellington.name: Marcus Wellington
marcus wellington.origin: An industrialist and head of Marcus Amalgamated, Marcus Wellington was the third richest man specializing in computer hardware and software and later expanding into manufacturing and munitions. Developing a computer virus that would devastate the world, he was enraged when his daughter, Melodi, stole the virus and fled with her boyfriend. When Melody was captured by the Irkutsk Liberation Front, Wellington hired mercenary and fellow industrialist Arno Stark aka Iron Man, to rescue his daughter (and the virus she carried). When Stark learned of the virus after rescuing the girl, he went to Wellington's company headquarters, where he found a heavily armored Wellington waiting for him. During the ensuing struggle, Stark introduced the virus into Wellington's armor, causing it to malfunction and the automatic missiles he deployed to not recognize him, causing them to track and destroy him. Following this, his daughter and Wellington's former assistant "Howard" (secretly Tony Stark) took control of Marcus Amalgamated with the hopes of legitimizing the business.

mardj.name: Mardj
mardj.origin: Mardj is a Tryfan freedom fighter from Sub-Atomica whose home had been invaded by Nillan conquerors. After passing through the Last Door, Mardj encountered the Scarlet Witch and Polaris, who agreed to join her on a quest to find a legendary weapon called the Sword in the Star. Although the Sword initially appeared to be nothing more than a myth, with Wanda and Lorna's aid, Mardj was able to forge and consecrate the blade herself. Sword in hand, Mardj and her companions were able to turn the tide against the Nillan invaders.

margaret braddock.name: Margaret Braddock
margaret braddock.origin: ===Origins=== left|thumb|A highly intelligent toddler Margaret "Maggie" Braddock is the daughter of Brian and Meggan Puceanu Braddock. Shortly after her birth, the family moved to the Braddock Lighthouse, where Maggie displayed remarkable intelligence, speaking in full sentences by the age of three months. Her parents’ former teammates, Kitty Pride, Nightcrawler, and Prestige, became her godparents, and she shared her first Christmas with her aunt Elizabeth Braddock as she learned to walk. ===Otherworld=== thumb|120px|Princess of Avalon The family later relocated to Braddock Manor, where Elizabeth briefly joined them. Amid rising anti-mutant sentiment in England and Brian’s disappearance, Meggan moved with Maggie to Krakoa, where she met her uncle Jamie Braddock Jr. After Jamie became king of Avalon and Brian was named Captain Avalon, the family settled in Castle Camelot in Otherworld. Maggie’s intellect continued to flourish, assisting her mother Meggan in her role as court sorceress. Her fae heritage, inherited from Meggan, became more pronounced during their time in Avalon. Maggie frequently used Krakoan gateways to visit Earth, particularly the Braddock Lighthouse, where Excalibur and her aunt Elizabeth resided. Her ability to use the mutant-exclusive gates suggests she is a mutant. Maggie later accompanied her family to the Starlight Citadel to witness Saturnyne’s trial of the false Captains Britain during Avalon’s civil war. Displaying keen strategic skills, she aided her family in war tactics. Despite efforts to evacuate her to Earth for safety, Maggie refused to leave without her mother. When Merlyn’s forces conquered Castle Camelot, the Braddocks escaped to the Braddock Lighthouse. left|150px|thumb|A strategic mind ===Back to Earth=== Eventually, the family relocated to Braddock Manor, which was moved to Braddock Isle. Maggie spent more time with her aunt Elizabeth, who often babysat her, and developed a fondness for Rachel Summers’ pet warwolf puppy, Amazing Baby. When Morgan Le Fay and Doctor Doom allied to attack Captain Britain, Maggie again contributed to the family’s strategies, collaborating with S.T.R.I.K.E.'s Psi Division. After neutralizing Morgan Le Fay’s threat, Brian took a teaching position at Braddock Academy, and the family returned to Braddock Manor in Essex.

margaret dillon.origin: Maggie Dillon was hired by Tony Stark to contact Arthur Parks, the Living Laser, using "telepathic intrabeam particle communication" technology. Initial attempts caused Dr. Dillon to have seizure like symptoms and brief cardiac arrest. Additional monitoring and protective gear was added; Maggie refused to abort as she felt progress was being made. The process of doing so fatally wounded Maggie.

margaret dultry.name: Margaret Dultry
margaret dultry.origin: Margaret Dultry was the sister of Dragonfly (Veronica Dultry). Returning from the Stranger's world, Veronica sought Margaret's help before mutating into a more insect-like form. Margaret sought to exploit her sister for illicit gains and hired Scott Lang to build a pen for Dragonfly. Lang realized something was fishy and, after finishing the pen, returned as Ant-Man, snuck inside, and found Veronica. Margaret discovered Ant-Man and tried to drown both him and Veronica but he managed to escape. Margaret then tried to hide Veronica, but when Ant-Man returned the next day with the police, he quickly found her and Margaret was arrested.

margaret lippincott.name: Margaret Lippincott
margaret lippincott.origin: Martin Lippincott, industrial tycoon, embodies the epitome of masculinity; a miner who rose to a filthy rich captain of industry, he finds fault in all those who fail to live up to his hyper-masculine expectations. One of those people who fails to meet those expectations is his son, Ronald. While Martin would prefer his son engage in things like boxing, or taking up engineering in order to one day take on the Lippincott family business, Ronald desires to be a doctor, and devotes his time to his studies. After Martin calls Ronald a gutless coward, Ronald's mother Margaret suggests Ronald accompany his father on his annual big game hunting trip to Africa. Ronald agrees, and Martin is ecstatic. Ronald and Martin's entire relationship changes; they go to movie premieres and watch New York Yankees games, and become close friends. They eventually travel to Africa, along with Margaret, only to find that the village of their guide Zumbo is deserted. They learn that a large gorilla has killed a number of villagers, but Martin decides to proceed with the hunt anyway. After trekking through the jungles, they happen upon a lion. Martin insists Ronald takes the kill, but Ronald hesitates and the lion attacks. Martin manages to shoot the lion before it harms anyone. Infuriated, Martin disowns Ronald, and they head back. On their way back to the village, the large gorilla Zumbo warned them about attacks and carries Martin away. Ronald and his mother follow their trail, and Ronald attacks and kills the Gorilla with a makeshift spear. In the struggle, Ronald kills the gorilla, but has his back clawed by the beast, and passes out. While Margaret nurses both Martin and Ronald back to health, the local villagers grow worried when the family doesn't return. After searching for them, they bring the family back to the village, and, impressed by Ronald's bravery, the African tribe makes Ronald their first white chief. Martin grows to accept his son's medical career decisions, and tearfully confesses how impressed he is in Ronald.
